offers_products.reason: Sells devices such as Integra Dermal Regeneration Template, DuraGen, NeuraGen, hydrocephalus valves, CUSA and surgical instruments.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured devices; surgeon training and biomaterial contract manufacturing are minor side offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Products are chosen and bought by surgeons and hospitals, not by individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to hospitals, surgical centers and device companies (private label, material supply).

recurring_revenue.reason: Hospitals repeatedly reorder single-use implants, grafts, wound care products and consumables for ongoing procedures.

cyclical_demand.reason: Neurosurgery, wound care and reconstruction products are medically necessary and used in procedures hospitals keep performing.

big_ticket.reason: Surgical instruments, grafts, nerve guides and valves are purchased frequently in modest amounts per procedure.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured medical devices and biomaterials, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are hospitals, health systems and surgical centers, often through group purchasing, plus medical device partners.

asset_heavy.reason: Medical device maker with manufacturing sites, but not heavy infrastructure like utilities or fleets; moderate capital needs.

notes: Surgeons and patients influence product choice, but hospitals buy and receive the products.
